fixes.explanation: Yes! "The LORD sets the prisoners free…" (Psalm 146:7) It comes right after the food for the hungry. That line gets me every single time, friend. Somebody locked up, and the LORD is the One opening the door.

That's the promise, baker. The writer says, "I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being." (Psalm 146:2) He's saying what he plans to do, and he doesn't hang any conditions on it. I wish I could make promises that big, because I once swore I'd only eat ONE broken cookie per batch.

That's right. The psalm says his plans perish "on that very day…" (Psalm 146:4) When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground, and his plans perish the same day. A prince can have the biggest plans in the kingdom, and the psalm still says they perish.

That's it, friend. "Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God…" (Psalm 146:5) Help and hope land in the same place. The God of Jacob is the God who spoke to Jacob, whom God also named Israel (Genesis 35:10).

Right. The psalm says, "He remains faithful forever." (Psalm 146:6) It doesn't say "as long as," and it doesn't hang His faithfulness on anyone else. Compare that to the man in verse 4, whose plans perish the day his spirit departs.

There it is, baker. "He executes justice for the oppressed…" (Psalm 146:7) It's the first thing named in the list, and the very next line is food for the hungry. The oppressed are the ones this verse says He brings justice to.

I see why you'd pick that, friend, but the proud don't show up in this line. It says, "The LORD sets the prisoners free…" (Psalm 146:7) Look at the whole list: the oppressed, the hungry, the prisoners. Not one of them is sitting on a throne, and I think that tells you where this psalm's heart is.

That's not what the psalm says, baker. It says, "…the ways of the wicked He frustrates." (Psalm 146:9) Leaving them alone would be nothing, and this verse says He does something. Their ways get blocked like a cookie sheet that won't fit in the oven.
